scripts.dev: node scripts/gen-tokens.ts && wrangler d1 migrations apply longshelf --local && vite dev
scripts.dev:calibre: node scripts/gen-tokens.ts && wrangler d1 migrations apply longshelf --local && LONGSHELF_LOCAL_CALIBRE=1 vite dev
scripts.build: node scripts/gen-tokens.ts && wrangler types && vite build
scripts.deploy: pnpm run build && wrangler d1 migrations apply longshelf --remote && wrangler deploy
scripts.preview: wrangler d1 migrations apply longshelf --local && wrangler dev .svelte-kit/cloudflare/_worker.js --port 4173 --local-upstream localhost --var LONGSHELF_DEV_IDENTITY:1
scripts.typecheck: node scripts/gen-tokens.ts && wrangler types && svelte-kit sync && svelte-check --tsconfig ./tsconfig.json
scripts.ai:neighbours: wrangler d1 migrations apply longshelf --local && node scripts/build-neighbours.ts
scripts.dev:remote: node scripts/gen-tokens.ts && wrangler d1 migrations apply longshelf --local && vite dev
